name: Wooden Shield
desc: A useful off-hand item to block hits from enemies.

name: Toxic Defender
desc: A shield covered in toxic grime. Has a chance to poison enemies when blocking attacks.

name: Octarine Shield
desc: An extremely durable shield infused with energy that increases health while holding it.

name: Iron Shield
desc: A heraldic shield offering significant protection from attacks.

name: Minion Detonator
desc: A pristine skull crest turning conjured sparks of life into ones of greater death.

name: Minion Kindler
desc: A rusted skull crest turning conjured sparks of life into ones of lesser death.

name: Swift Feather
desc: A mysterious feather that allows you to dash out of danger.

name: Azeos' Dash Feather
desc: A colorful talon feather from Azeos, the Sky Titan. By holding it you can dash at a high speed.

name: Blue Leather Tome
desc: An ancient book with stitched blue covers. Is that skin?

name: Golden Jellyfish
desc: This rare jellyfish seems to do well without water and apparently it likes your company.

name: Caveling ID
desc: A sturdy card that once belonged to a citizen of the forlorn metropolis. It's thousand of years old but the excellent print hasn't faded.

name: Turtle Shell
desc: A hard shell that once belonged to a graceful sea creature. You feel much more protected when holding it.

name: Omoroth's Beak
desc: The sharp mouth piece of Omoroth, the Sea Titan. It seems to be able to crush every material.

name: Sentry Shield
desc: The discarded breast piece of a core sentry. It has just the right size to be used as a great shield and the ancient gemstone in its center sometimes shoots out energy as it blocks enemy attacks.

name: Royal Gel
desc: A blob of slime with a tiny crown in its center. With the right headpiece you can reign over all slimes.

name: Crystal Meteor Chunk
desc: A very big ancient gemstone fused from smaller shards. It emits a strange energy that makes you feel nauseous and feverish.

name: Scorching Aegis
desc: The crust of molten rock, formed to be wielded like a shield.

name: Concealed Blade
desc: A knife attached to a wrist band hidden among layers of fabric. It's perfect for an unsuspected stealth attack.

name: Smithing Glove
desc: Reinforced with several rare materials, this glove can withstand great heat and is a must have for every experienced blacksmith.

name: Oracle Deck
desc: The complete set of oracle cards. Bringing them together strangely restored the cards to perfect condition and now they emit a powerful, enlightening aura.

name: Core Iris
desc: A manufactured crystal that looks like the eye of the core. This one is raw and unfinished, as if something interrupted the process.

name: Pet Rock
desc: It's Bob the pet rock. Don't drop or throw him, he has feelings too.

name: Hydra Bone Shield
desc: The heavy top part of a hydra's skull. Made to withstand deep pressure within the earth, it makes for a great protection in battle.

name: Hydra Tooth
desc: The long fang of a hydra. It emanates a primal energy that is waiting to be harnessed.

name: Trinity Heart
desc: A symbiosis of an ancient gemstone with organic matter, resulting in a physically impossible material. It pulsates in energetic rhythms of three, a celestial pattern that must have been of utter importance to a spacefaring species.

name: Rift Lens
desc: A peculiar handheld device, used for short range teleportation.

name: Moonstone
desc: This pristine crystal is filled with energy. It makes you feel determined.

name: Scratched Stone
desc: The claw marks in this rock reveal dormant energies inside, waiting to be awoken.

name: Magnet
desc: A magnet with an impressive draw that defies the limits of electromagnetics.

name: Remote Boom Clicker
desc: For when you want to make things go boom, but from a comfy distance!

name: Spicy Lure
desc: A well-seasoned type of lure that attracts fish and other things more quickly.

name: Sweet Lure
desc: A sugary type of lure that increases the chance of catching fish instead of loot.

name: Glowing Lure
desc: A luminous type of lure that increases the chance of pulling up loot.

name: Sticky Lure
desc: An icky type of lure that may stick on to fish that didn't even bite.

name: Expert Lure
desc: This lure consists of multiple edible and magical components, attracting the one big catch that lingers in deep waters. Is consumed on successful use.

name: Purple Lure
desc: A shimmering lure that catches the eye of more rare fish.

name: Green Lure
desc: A pointy lure that can stick to fish from the outside to catch more and catch them faster.

name: Red Lure
desc: A wiggly lure that looks like a red worm, large enough to allow more than one fish to get caught sometimes.

name: Copper Cross Necklace
desc: This pendant sharpens the focus, allowing for more precise hits.

name: Grub Egg Necklace
desc: This odd necklace seems to have a life of its own.

name: Iron Chunk Necklace
desc: A heavy piece of jewelry that increases defense.

name: Heart Berry Necklace
desc: A heart berry on the neck makes for an easy snack!

name: Ammonite Necklace
desc: Simple but beautiful necklace featuring a fossil.

name: Gold Crystal Necklace
desc: A shiny trinket combining the most valuable of materials.

name: Blob Rosary Necklace
desc: Sticky necklace infused with energy made for an unknown purpose.

name: Azeos Beak Necklace
desc: Forged from a piece of the sky titan's beak.

name: Remedaisy Necklace
desc: Jewelry made from a rare plant that repels poison.

name: Ancient Guardian Necklace
desc: A truly powerful relic of the past, made for fending off the strongest of foes.

name: Mold Vein Necklace
desc: A circle of white organic filaments, it latches onto the skin.

name: Cave Guppy Necklace
desc: Odd necklace made from a fish that never let go of the hook.

name: Bubble Pearl Necklace
desc: Natural grown jewelry made from rare bubble pearls.

name: Polished Copper Cross Necklace
desc: This pendant sharpens the focus, allowing for more precise hits.

name: Polished Iron Chunk Necklace
desc: A heavy piece of jewelry that increases defense.

name: Polished Gold Crystal Necklace
desc: A shiny trinket combining the most valuable of materials.

name: Ancient Gem Necklace
desc: A necklace crafted with only using ancient gemstones as well as a super rare white version.

name: Skull Necklace
desc: A morbid necklace made from tiny caveling skulls. They're too small to have been children.

name: Eostre Necklace
desc: A curved twig holding a golden egg at its end. It is a sign of renewal and fertility.

name: Neptune Necklace
desc: A true trinket of the sea, made from kelp and a trident pendant. Mistaking you for a mythic sea ruler, fish come to you more often.

name: Omoroth's Necklace
desc: A piece of jewelry with a striking likeness to the sea titan. Wearing it you feel in tune with the Sunken Sea, enhancing your body in multiple ways.

name: Octarine Necklace
desc: A necklace made from pure octarine filled with magic energy.

name: Scarlet Chunk Necklace
desc: The scarlet variant of an iron chunk necklace. It raises your defense even more and gives additional benefits.

name: Coral Amulet
desc: A necklace made with a pretty coral badge and white pebbles.

name: Polished Octarine Necklace
desc: A necklace made from pure octarine filled with magic energy.

name: Polished Scarlet Chunk Necklace
desc: The scarlet variant of an iron chunk necklace. It raises your defense even more and gives additional benefits.

name: Polished Coral Amulet
desc: A necklace made with a pretty coral badge and white pebbles.

name: Conch Shell Necklace
desc: A beautiful necklace featuring a small shell. When you hold it up to your ear you can hear distant waves.

name: Oceanheart Necklace
desc: A big blue diamond is the centerpiece of this extraordinary treasure. You feel loved when holding it up to your chest.

name: Rusted Necklace
desc: This pendant used to look pretty but now it's rusted to the core.

name: Torc Necklace
desc: A piece of jewelry for the neck that's merely a hoop with a gap. Worn by many different cultures throughout world history.

name: Ra-Akar's Necklace
desc: A necklace of the desert with a strong resemblance of the sand titan. Wearing it grants you additional protection and extra damage.

name: Nomad Necklace
desc: Made from ragged cloth and metal badges this witness of the desert gives you a keen advantage on attacks.

name: Bone Necklace
desc: A primitive piece of jewelry made from small bones. Early humans have also made these for many different reasons.

name: Black Necklace
desc: A necklace made from pitch-black metal that leaves dark smudges on your neck.

name: Flame Necklace
desc: A mysterious necklace with a burning pendant. It glows intensively but doesn't scorch the skin.

name: Fusioned Chunk Necklace
desc: A misshappen necklace that combines chunks of all kinds of materials.

name: Samhain Offering Necklace
desc: A blessed necklace offered as a gift to farewell the warm season. It represents the harvest and the evening sun.

name: Valentine Necklace
desc: A golden necklace featuring a big, shiny heart. You feel something you can't describe, when wearing it so close to your own.

name: Fang Necklace
desc: A status symbol among tribal cavelings. You can sense blood lust from the loose tooth.

name: Wildwarden Necklace
desc: An animalistic emblem decorated with golden trinkets that ring out to the wild.

name: Atlantean Worm Necklace
desc: This organic necklace looks like a miniature version of the Atlantean Worm. Maybe it is a juvenile that would grow to become as large as its origin.

name: Tower Shell Necklace
desc: A necklace featuring a coiling shell. Its ever turning spiral structure is captivating.

name: Glass Bead Necklace
desc: A captivating necklace that catches your enemies off-guard so that they lower their defense. Unfortunately it has the same effect on you.

name: Pyrdra's Necklace
desc: A scorching necklace that imbues the holder with powers of the burning heat.

name: Crescent Necklace
desc: Grants the bearer access to deeper wellsprings of power.

name: Soul Medallion
desc: A depressing stone amulet. You hear whispering...

name: Bomb Necklace
desc: A necklace made from a fuse tied to a tiny bomb. Hold on to your head if it sizzles right next to your ear.

name: Black Charm Necklace
desc: A perfectly black trinket that absorbs any light cast upon it.

name: Clot Ring
desc: A blood-red ring that latches onto your finger.

name: Larva Ring
desc: A living ring, not for the squirmish to wear.

name: Wooden Thorn Ring
desc: A circular, brambly root with sharp thorns pointing outward.

name: Glow Tulip Ring
desc: A luminous ring that holds the essence of glow tulips.

name: Swift Ring
desc: Wearing this winged ring creates a slight wind that pushes you forward.

name: Ring of Rock
desc: Simple ring found in the deepest of rocks.

name: Ring of Stone
desc: Simple ring carved out of stone.

name: Gold Crystal Ring
desc: A precious ring featuring ancient gemstones.

name: Melting Crystal Ring
desc: A gooey ring dripping slippery slime on the floor.

name: Sky Ring
desc: This ring reminds you of the wide open sky.

name: Caveling Mother's Ring
desc: An old crystal ring, holding it fills you with a sad feeling you can't describe.

name: Petal Ring
desc: A precious ring that has naturally grown in the yellow blossoms of the jungle caves.

name: Mold Ring
desc: A soft ring slowly releasing mold spores.

name: Rusted Ring
desc: A ring from the depths that someone must have lost long time ago.

name: Sea Foam Ring
desc: A translucent ring that looks like a wave frozen in time.

name: Polished Gold Crystal Ring
desc: A precious ring featuring ancient gemstones.

name: Polished Glow Tulip Ring
desc: A luminous ring that holds the essence of glow tulips.

name: Polished Swift Ring
desc: Wearing this winged ring creates a slight wind that pushes you forward.

name: Ancient Gem Ring
desc: This mysterious ring is entirely made out of ancient gemstones, featuring a super rare white one.

name: Ivy's Ring
desc: An organic ring grown from slime covered thorns.

name: Skull Ring
desc: A grotesque blood-red ring, crested with a tiny caveling skull.

name: Ostara Ring
desc: A ring made of leaves and small golden eggs. It is a sign of emerging life and spring.

name: Morpha's Ring
desc: A strange, little loop made from blue slime, it almost slides off of your finger.

name: Coral Ring
desc: An intricate ring naturally grown from pink, branchy corals.

name: Goldfish Ring
desc: A quite lively little ring that tries to swim off of your finger. By the time it realizes it's merely a ring it has already forgot about it again.

name: Lucky Ring
desc: A cheaply made ring from a vending machine. If you believe hard enough you may feel more lucky.

name: Ancient Guardian Ring
desc: A relic that is made in the same way as the Ancient Guardian Necklace, made for fending off the strongest of foes.

name: Omoroth's Ring
desc: A plated looping tentacle that wraps around your finger. Stemming from a titan, it enhances your might in fighting these giant monsters.

name: Octarine Ring
desc: A ring made from pure octarine enhanced with magic properties.

name: Magnetic Ring
desc: A strange ring that pulls in loot around you in a higher radius. Magnets, how do they work?

name: Golden Spike Ring
desc: This golden ring is very uncomfortable to wear but it looks really cool.

name: Polished Octarine Ring
desc: A ring made from pure octarine enhanced with magic properties.

name: Polished Magnetic Ring
desc: A strange ring that pulls in loot around you in a higher radius. Magnets, how do they work?

name: Polished Golden Spike Ring
desc: This golden ring is very uncomfortable to wear but it looks really cool.

name: Spine Ring
desc: A ring found at the skeleton of a giant ocean creature. It's made from tiny cervical vertebrae.

name: Wooden Ring
desc: A simple wooden ring, nothing more, nothing less.

name: Topaz Ring
desc: A precious little ring with a yellow gemstone on top.

name: White Glass Ring
desc: This ring is made from a milky, translucent material. The light it reflects makes it harder for enemies to hit you.

name: Septum Ring
desc: A golden piece of jewelry that's not put onto the finger but rather on the nose.

name: Ring of Sand
desc: A strange ring made from sand that is held together by the currents of time.

name: Bone Ring
desc: A prehistoric, crude ring made from bone. Rings like these have been discovered in early human graves.

name: Nomad Ring
desc: This small finger band is made from ragged cloth to keep it from heating up in the scorching desert valleys.

name: Black Ring
desc: A ring made from pitch-black metal, darkened by the constant presence of immense heat.

name: Flame Ring
desc: This strange ring produces a flame that affects anything but its wearer.

name: Bomb Ring
desc: A ring crowned with a little bomb idol. Handling explosives while wearing it results in an even stronger blast.

name: Noble Ring
desc: An expensive looking ring featuring a ruby. It must have belonged to someone wealthy.

name: Double Ring
desc: This ring is made to be put on two fingers at the same time. Revolutionary.

name: Samhain Curse Ring
desc: A cursed ring that was used to welcome the cold season into the lands. It represents decay and darkness.

name: Valentine Ring
desc: A golden ring featuring a candy-colored heart. The perfect gift to give to someone you like.

name: Wildwarden Ring
desc: A wooden ring with two smaller rings around it. One symbolizes the warden and the other the bonded beast.

name: Atlantean Worm Ring
desc: An organic ring that looks like one of the segments of the Atlantean Worm. It must have grown inside its body as an anomaly.

name: Glass Bead Ring
desc: A captivating ring that catches your enemies off-guard so that they lower their defense. Unfortunately it has the same effect on you.

name: Druidra's Ring
desc: A leafy ring that imbues the holder with powers of the poisonous nature.

name: Crydra's Ring
desc: An icy ring that imbues the holder with powers of the cold elements.

name: Crescent Ring
desc: Allows the bearer to reach further sources of wisdom.

name: Hourglass Ring
desc: Has a small hourglass on top. The sand within has stopped flowing down.

name: Vicious Ring
desc: The unsettling gaze of this ring causes minions to stay on high alert.

name: Boundary Ring
desc: A simple ring that forms a magical veil.

name: Puppet Ring
desc: An odd, ornate ring. You feel a closer bond with your minions whilst wearing it.

name: Aether Ring
desc: A ring with tiny sconces that come ablaze with purple flames when you wear it.

name: Helical Ring
desc: A nut fastener just the right size for your finger.
